subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should chat `/status` and `session_status` support a per-agent field policy, a whole-card switch, or remain always visible?
rationale: The choice adds public configuration and determines how operator diagnostics and potentially sensitive provider/session information are exposed in shared-agent use.

options.title: Per-agent field policy
options.body: Add a typed allowlist or suppression policy at the shared renderer so sensitive sections can be hidden without discarding all diagnostics.

options.title: Whole-card switch
options.body: Add one inherited boolean that suppresses rendered status text while retaining current behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Reject new configuration and explicitly document these status surfaces as operator-visible diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Per-agent field policy
recommendation.body: Add a typed allowlist or suppression policy at the shared renderer so sensitive sections can be hidden without discarding all diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent status-output ownership signals and already articulated the unresolved product and security choices in the issue discussion.
